name: path: a click on a step keeps the step in the back stack
why: _dpJumpTo(i) shows step i and keeps the steps BEFORE it; keeping step i too puts what the window shows on its own back stack, so the path repeats it.
grep: a click on an earlier step goes back to it

name: path: a narrow window keeps three steps
why: Below _DP_PATH_NARROW_PX the path keeps two steps after "…" (vzell, 2026-10-28).
grep: a narrow window keeps two steps

name: path: steps read their kind whatever the setting says
why: The default (sa_dp_path_label 'name') reads each step's name; a step reading its kind would pass every kind-path spec and fail only the names test.

name: path: an editing history reads a name
why: A view (_DP_VIEW_TYPES) reads its kind even in names mode; without 'edits' in the set the history step reads the release's name.

name: path: Space on a step's card pins nothing and goes nowhere
why: Space on a step's card goes back to that step, as a click; without the branch the card falls through to _dpOpenDialog(), which starts a new path on a target the dialog cannot show.
grep: resting on a step shows its own card

name: path: a step's card keeps its source's "Space more" foot
why: On a step Space goes back; the source's own foot line would say it shows more.
grep: resting on a step shows its own card

name: path: a glyph's documentation is read from the glyph's own link
why: The glyph's link holds an image, and _mbPopTarget() takes a link holding an image for artwork: no documentation target, so no card and the click opens a new tab.

edits.find: const r = _mbPopTarget(bare, { inWindow: true, mbOrigin: true });
edits.replace: const r = _mbPopTarget(a, { inWindow: true, mbOrigin: true });

name: item 3: an MB glyph on discogs.com names discogs.com
why: On another site this origin's /static/images/entity/… is that site's; the glyph must come from musicbrainz.org.

edits.replace: const res = await _extFetch(url, { session: false, maxBytes: _MB_FOREIGN_PAGE_MAX, maxDownload: _MB_FOREIGN_PAGE_MAX });

why: _mbEditsSubject() answered null on every foreign host, so the window had no ✎ button.

why: dg-mb targets were noLive (the browser check); with the cookie request they have one.

why: _mbEditsUrl() built on window.location.origin, which on discogs.com names discogs.com.

why: _dgMbWinTarget() knew entities by MBID only; a genre links /tag/<name> (vzell, 2026-10-28: no card, no drill-down).

name: item 3: an MB glyph's documentation on discogs.com opens a new tab
why: _dpDocTarget() read MusicBrainz's documentation on MusicBrainz only; with the cookie request discogs.com reads it too (vzell, 2026-10-28).

name: item 3 (P2): ⟳ reads back the archive's failure
why: _artFetchEntityImages() keeps a 429/5xx for the session; without forgetting it on ⟳ the strip never asks again.

name: settings audit: a window filter's highlight falls back to the text's colour
why: With sa_column_filter_highlight_color stored empty the tables fall back to red; the window's mark.mb-dg-hl fell back to 'inherit' (the audit's drifting fallback, fixed 2026-10-28).
grep: a colour stored empty falls back

name: Discogs glyph: the emoji as text changes the title's text
why: The glyph is CSS generated content so the title (and a card's kind line) reads the labels alone; as text, 'Discogs release › Discogs artist' gains its emoji.

name: item 4: a Discogs window has no ✎ Editing history
why: _dgHistSubject() names what a Discogs window has a history of; answering '' hides the button and H.

name: item 4: a Discogs window's ✎ gets the MusicBrainz presets' ▾
why: vzell: the button 'without the menu structure'; the ▾ is a MusicBrainz entity's only.

name: item 4: H does nothing in a Discogs window
why: H asked _mbEditsSubject() only; a Discogs window has a history too (_dpHasHistory()).

name: item 4: the history reader reads releases only
why: _EXT_DGH_PATH_RE took /release/<id>/history only; an artist's history link was then the plain Discogs reader's.

name: item 4: murdos' importer's glyph taken for the subject's picture
why: A page saved from a browser carries the importer's musicbrainz.org link and glyph first in its <h1>; the parser must skip them.

name: history window: the kind column as it was (8.5em, the pill not cut)
why: vzell, 2026-10-28: 'Edit Master Release' ran into the note. Both halves restored, since the ellipsis alone would also keep the pill in its column.

name: discogs.com: the importer's icon in our heading has no card
why: _dgMbSource()'s selector covered our table bodies and Discogs' #app only (vzell, 2026-10-28).

name: discogs.com: no "✎ Edit history" in the SAED menu
why: vzell, 2026-10-28: the menu gets the page entity's Discogs edit history on the IP and the FRP.

name: item 4: an earlier page read is not shown
why: _extDgHistPagesMerged() puts the earlier pages read in front of the newest; without them the window shows the newest page only.
